title: Production Policy
description: The single authoritative, versioned source for workflow limits, per-dimension gate thresholds, candidate policy, extraction thresholds, context-tail budgets and the issue-override matrix (ADR-0041, ADR-0042). One shipped starting version per quality tier; projects pin a version at job start. All numbers are starting values with calibration status (ADR-0029).

content_hash.description: sha256 of the canonical JSON without this field

per_span_attempts.description: Attempts on one span before escalating scope

smoke_after_patches.description: Cumulative patches after which both judges re-run on the whole chapter

regression_tolerance_points.description: Max allowed per-dimension score drop between versions

early_stop_margin_points.description: Stop generating further candidates when an auto-approvable candidate exceeds EVERY gated dimension's threshold by at least this margin (per dimension; never an aggregate)

tie_fallback_ladder_authorized.description: Authorizes the deterministic ADR-0015 tie ladder (higher gated-dimension total → fewer patches → lower candidate slot) to decide a pair the position-swapped comparator could not separate. When false, an unresolved pair ends the selection in needs_attention instead of being decided by a fallback. This is the ONLY authorization for the ladder; no other policy field may be read as implying it.

selection_schedule.description: How N candidates are reduced to one. stable_slot_single_elimination: candidates are ordered by their stable slot and reduced by sequential single elimination. The outcome is deterministic FOR THIS PINNED SCHEDULE and the schedule is persisted as provenance; it is not a claim of schedule-independent global optimality, because the pairwise comparator is not guaranteed transitive (ADR-0015).

gates.description: Per-dimension acceptance. auto_approvable = all deterministic criteria pass AND blocking_count = 0 AND major_count = 0 AND every listed dimension score >= its threshold. No aggregate score is ever used.

minor_below.description: Model issues below this confidence are capped at minor

drift_flag_scene_repair_ratio.description: Share of paragraphs flagged for one drift class (at judge confidence >= drift_flag_min_confidence) that triggers a scene-level repair plan instead of per-paragraph patches

chapter_regenerate_ratio.description: Share of flagged paragraphs above which the chapter is regenerated

previous_tail_words.description: Verbatim tail of the previous accepted chapter (sentence-aligned)

previous_tail_floor_words.description: Lowest the degradation ladder may shrink the tail to

previous_tail_extend_to_scene_below_word.description: Extend the tail backward to the start of the last scene when that scene is shorter than this

input_budget_tokens.description: Input token budget per pack template other than the writer (which uses writer_input_budget_tokens); keys are template names such as pack.chapter_planner

passes.description: Independent extractor passes (2 = A and B)

single_source_min_confidence.description: Only-in-one-pass items at or above this confidence with verifiable evidence are accepted as single_source; below → adjudicate

fuzzy_anchor_min_ratio.description: Evidence quotes not found exactly may be re-anchored when similarity >= this ratio; else the item is rejected

override_matrix.description: issue kind → override class (ADR-0042). Kinds not listed default to `reviewer` for major and `advisory` for minor/note.

project_escalations.description: Project-level raises (kind → class); may only raise, never lower

judge_weight.description: Share of the dimension score from the judge; the remainder comes from the deterministic composite (lint / register / terminology)
